description: This PHP source file defines a class 'DomainListener' that handles domain-based redirection and controller assignment in a Symfony-based application, specifically for custom domain management within the Goteo framework.

classes.name: DomainListener
classes.description: A listener class that manages domain-based redirection and controller logic for custom domains in a Symfony application.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming requests to perform domain redirection based on configuration and request parameters.

methods.name: onController
methods.description: Modifies the controller for the request based on domain and path, including language menu adjustments.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this listener subscribes to, specifically request and controller events.
